more_info.overview: Tartaric acid is used as a sequestrant in food. Its technological role is to bind metal ions.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, cocoa and chocolate products as covered by directive 2000/36/ec, table-top sweeteners in tablets. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: 0-30 mg/kg body weight (JECFA, 2017). The combined group limit is expressed as L(+)-tartaric acid.
